per_requirement.extracted_requirement: The application must respond to routine navigations and small queries within 5 seconds.
per_requirement.matched_ground_truth: 'The maximum wait time for a user navigating from one screen to another within the Disputes application shall be no more than 5 seconds.'

per_requirement.extracted_requirement: The application must support 350 concurrent users without performance degradation.
per_requirement.matched_ground_truth: 'The Disputes application shall support 350 concurrent users without any degradation of performance in the application.'

per_requirement.extracted_requirement: The application must implement retries and idempotency for external calls to prevent inconsistent state.
The application must degrade gracefully when backend systems are unavailable.
The application must enforce role-based access control and record user actions for audits.
per_requirement.matched_ground_truth: 'The Disputes application shall ensure that only users with the appropriate access level are allowed to initiate dispute requests.'

per_requirement.extracted_requirement: The application must follow corporate UI standards for a consistent user experience.
per_requirement.matched_ground_truth: 'The Disputes application shall comply with the corporate standards for user interface creation for internally and externally used applications.'

per_requirement.extracted_requirement: The application must record every action that affects case state or triggers an external request, including who performed it, when, and the payload and responses.
The application must ensure that internal-only fields are not exposed to merchants or cardmembers.
per_requirement.matched_ground_truth: 'The Disputes application shall ensure that only users with the appropriate access level are allowed to initiate dispute requests.'

per_requirement.extracted_requirement: The application must always source core transaction attributes like amount and timestamps from the statement database.
per_requirement.matched_ground_truth: 'The Disputes application shall interface with the Statement Database. The Statement Database provides the transaction details to the Disputes System. All transaction details must be obtained from the Statement Database'
